plan.title: Forward auction rejects start price above end price

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow required for auction configuration.
Configure a price-based auction, the closest catalog representation of the requested forward auction.
Provide the mandatory event title so the test reaches the auction validation rather than failing on a missing title.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet and auction fields can be configured.
Add the requested product and quantity; the location is set separately because add_line_items has no location argument.
Populate the required pricing sheet before configuring the schedule and participants.
Enter the requested plant/location in the closest available sheet column.
Verify that the requested location value was retained in the first row.
Set the forward auction start price to 200.
Set the forward auction end price to 100, creating the invalid greater-start-than-end configuration.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule before attempting publication.
Add the two vendors named in the case so participant validation does not mask the auction price validation.
